capabilities.description: Executable reports a parseable version inside the compatible range.
A bounded synthetic query returns the expected structural nodes.
A bounded synthetic path query returns the expected two-hop relationship.
A bounded synthetic explanation returns node and connection metadata.
The raw graph is valid JSON below graphify-out and remains ignored local state.
Structural mode is local-only, while semantic/deep mode requires an explicit provider, external boundary, and positive cost cap.
Graph baseline, current commit, and merge base classify freshness as fresh, stale, diverged, or unknown.
